name: Cryptids Expansion: Midnight Field Guide
description: Twenty lore-rich cryptid cards for Truth and Government forces locking horns over monster sightings.
author: Paranoid Times Narrative Desk

cards.name: Mothman Mutual Aid Hotline
cards.text: +2% Truth. If you're behind on states, add +1 Pressure anywhere.
cards.flavor: Call center reroutes through the Paranoid Times midnight desk for emergency winged omens.

cards.name: Chupacabra Stakeout Meetup
cards.text: +2 Pressure. If Truth ≥ 55%, add +1 more Pressure.
cards.flavor: Florida Man supplies goats; Maria Chen supplies night-vision rosaries.

cards.name: Loch Ness Livestream
cards.text: +3% Truth. If Truth ≥ 60%, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Streaming kit borrows sonar from the Denver Airport maintenance bay.

cards.name: Sasquatch Doorbell Cam Cooperative
cards.text: +1 Pressure plus +1 per state you control (max +2).
cards.flavor: Elvis repurposes smart doorbells into Sasquatch recognition arrays.

cards.name: Jersey Devil Flyers
cards.text: Opponent −1 IP. If you're behind on states, opponent loses 1 additional IP.
cards.flavor: Print run flagged by the Bureau of Uncanny Printing before dawn.

cards.name: Thunderbird Skywriting Crew
cards.text: +3% Truth. If you control 6+ states, add +2 Pressure anywhere.
cards.flavor: Bat Boy handles pyrotechnics while the TruthMeter™ logs each contrail.

cards.name: Flatwoods EMF Revival
cards.text: +2% Truth. If Truth ≤ 45%, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Pastor Rex hands out EMF hymnals tuned by Hamtrak technicians.

cards.name: Lizardman Bayou Radio
cards.text: +1% Truth. If you're behind on states, gain +1% Truth again.
cards.flavor: Swamp transmitters run on Doomsday Beans™ biodiesel.

cards.name: International Bat Boy Congress
cards.text: +3 Pressure and all your states gain +1 Defense.
cards.flavor: Delegates issue ultraviolet parchment resolutions to every safe house.

cards.name: TruthMeter™ Monster Census
cards.text: +2% Truth plus +1% per state you control (max +6%). If Truth ≥ 65%, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: TruthMeter™ drones sweep national parks for unreported footprints.

cards.name: Department of Myth Management
cards.text: −3% Truth. If Truth ≥ 60%, opponent loses 1 IP.
cards.flavor: Karen Walsh files another denial into Project Avalon archives.

cards.name: Operation Silver Net
cards.text: Opponent −2 IP. If you control 6+ states, opponent loses 1 additional IP.
cards.flavor: General Thompson syncs drone nets with Denver Airport satellites.

cards.name: Friendly Cryptid Curfew
cards.text: +2 Pressure and all your states gain +1 Defense.
cards.flavor: Curfew alerts ping through the Domestic Anomaly PA system.

cards.name: Lair Rezoning Committee
cards.text: +1 Pressure plus +1 per state you control (max +2).
cards.flavor: Minutes note: 'Chupacabra relocation to Business Park D pending.'

cards.name: Tourism Denial Brochure
cards.text: −1% Truth. If Truth ≥ 55%, reduce Truth by 1% more.
cards.flavor: Printed with ink straight from the Bureau of Narrative Correction.

cards.name: Suppression Memo: Lake Monster
cards.text: −2% Truth. If you control 5+ states, opponent discards 1 card.
cards.flavor: Memo suggests renaming Nessie to 'Glacial Anomaly 12b.'

cards.name: Containment Subsidy Program
cards.text: Opponent −2 IP. If Truth ≥ 65%, opponent loses 1 additional IP.
cards.flavor: Participants receive tax credits denominated in black-budget bonds.

cards.name: Drone Fog Deployment
cards.text: +3 Pressure. If Truth ≥ 65%, add +1 more Pressure.
cards.flavor: Atmospheric Cover Unit calibrates cloaking mist to TruthMeter™ blind spots.

cards.name: Redacted Ranger Briefing
cards.text: −1% Truth. If you control 4+ states, add +1 Pressure anywhere.
cards.flavor: Briefing binder arrives with 47 pages missing and one silver bullet.

cards.name: Total Information Awareness: Cryptid Annex
cards.text: −4% Truth. If you control 6+ states, opponent discards 1 card.
cards.flavor: Adds sensor feeds from Project Blue Brook to the master database.
